anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted at length from the LXX (sheep to slaughter; generation; poor and rich; no sin, no deceit).
He did no sin, nor was deceit found in his mouth.

pass_a_gloss: For to these the salvation came about through his blood, of Christ as of an unblemished lamb. For as a sheep he was led upon slaughter, and as a lamb before the one shearing it voiceless, so he does not open the mouth. Who will recount his generation, because his life is taken from the earth, and from the lawlessnesses of his people he was led into his death. And I will give the poor instead of his death and the rich instead of his burial, because he did not do sin nor was deceit found in his mouth.
pass_b_english: For to these the salvation has come about through his blood, of Christ as of an unblemished lamb. For "as a sheep he was led to slaughter, and as a lamb before the one who shears it is voiceless, so he does not open his mouth. Who will recount his generation, because his life is taken from the earth, and from the lawlessness of his people he was led to his death. And I will give the poor in return for his death and the rich in return for his burial, because he did no sin, nor was deceit found in his mouth."
source_text: Τούτοις γὰρ ἡ σωτηρία περιεγένετο διὰ {τῆς} τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ τοῦ ὡς ἀμνοῦ ἀμώμου Χ(ριστο)ῦ · τὸ γὰρ "ὡς πρόβατον ἐπὶ σφαγὴν ἤχθη, καὶ ὡς ἀμνὸς ἐναντίον τοῦ κείροντος αὐτὸν ἄφωνος, οὕτως οὐκ ἀνοίγει τὸ στόμα. Τὴν γενεὰν αὐτοῦ τίς διηγήσεται, ὅτι αἴρεται ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἡ ζωὴ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνομιῶν τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἤχθη εἰς θάνατον [αὐ]τοῦ. Καὶ δώσω τοὺς πτω[χοὺς ἀντὶ] τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ [καὶ τοὺς π]λουσίους ἀντὶ τῆς [τ]αφῆς αὐ[τ]οῦ, ὅτι ἁμαρτίαν [ο]ὐκ ἐποίησεν οὐδὲ εὑρέθη δόλος ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ".
